definitions.ask: Should reconcile apply name repairs when its phase lands, after a live-vault dry run?
definitions.why: Writer fixes land first, and every repair is reported and git-revertable

choices.label: Repairs write as soon as the phase lands; a read-only live-vault dry run checks them first
Ship report-only; a follow-up bead turns on writes after a day or two of reports

definitions.ask: Should a MEET Event Task link grow a work entry's name (BUILD to BUILD + MEET), as Enter landing does?
definitions.why: One add rule for landing and reconcile keeps every gesture's output a fixed point

choices.label: Reconcile appends MEET like any type; the session counts toward MEET in Stats
Reconcile leaves the name and reports the link; Enter landing is unchanged
